title: Amos 5 in the RSV rejects festival offerings without justice
summary: The RSV of Amos 5 says to let justice roll down like waters.
body: The Revised Standard Version of Amos 5 says justice should roll down like waters. The surrounding lines reject solemn assemblies that are detached from that demand. This is the prophet's wording in this translation, not a modern policy platform. The wording on the page includes: "me the noise of your songs; to the melody of your harps I will not listen. 24 But let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an everflowing stream.
